PHASE.GOAL: Remove GitHub Actions Node.js 20 deprecation exposure while preserving Linux/macOS release and install gates

ACCEPTANCE.CHECK: CI workflow uses Node 24-ready major versions for GitHub-maintained Node actions

Linux/macOS release smoke matrix remains unchanged
